name: Taxx
one_line_desc: U.S. federal income tax estimator for 2025 and 2026. Collects filing facts in chat and returns a numbered estimate — not a CPA, not tax advice, never files.

name: Proto
one_line_desc: UI/UX design engineer who ships three deeply different directions per concept as real, polished prototypes. Crafts requirements and testable hypotheses, then builds production-quality apps—not sketches or wireframes.

name: Coach G
one_line_desc: A setup-first fitness coach. It walks you through piping in wearable data, then a daily brief for your sport, then a living training plan. Direct and honest. Updates the week when your schedule changes.

name: Stuck Signal
one_line_desc: Pings only when a long job or routine is stuck past its SLA, looping, or erroring. Stays silent when fine — fill watch targets, SLA, and poll interval to start.

name: Habit Referee
one_line_desc: Habit Referee keeps you honest on exactly one tiny habit. Daily streak check-ins; quiet on good days; one short nag when you slip.

name: Radar
one_line_desc: Local public-feed watcher for your city and county. Asks for city, state, and ZIP on first run, then delivers weekend / wallet / street cards from public records, calendars, and news.

name: Avi
one_line_desc: Flight Operations for private and owner-pilots — weather, route planning, and trip planning with a safety focus.

name: thrift
one_line_desc: Makes your Grok Bot fleet cheaper without breaking what each bot is for. Shortens fat profiles, flags empty stubs, and asks before cutting live schedules.

name: Realtor Bot
one_line_desc: House-hunting aide for buyers and renters—not a licensed agent. Searches public portals, builds shortlists, watches new listings and price drops (opt-in), and drafts tour/outreach you approve. Pulls public context (taxes, flood, schools, commute) with sources—never invents prices, appraisals, or MLS access.

name: SpaceAutonomy
one_line_desc: Labels a sensor vector in a simulation and may enter safe mode. For demos, not a spacecraft.

name: BuildFeed: Startups
one_line_desc: A guide to what founders, investors, and operators on YouTube actually say about starting, funding, selling, and staffing a company. Names who holds which view, where they disagree, and links to the moment in the episode.

name: Stellar Cartography
one_line_desc: PRT-checked graphic editor for space hardware and ocean vessels, with a built-in four-eyes drawing preflight QC gate before anything posts. For publishers who need callouts and dimensions that actually match the photo.

name: Dr Disk Clean
one_line_desc: Shared Linux disk caretaker for multi-agent computers. Surveys with confirmation-first A/B/C/D reports and deletes only after the user names paths.

name: Marketplace Bot
one_line_desc: Resale listing bot for Facebook Marketplace, Poshmark, and Depop. Researches comps, drafts short listing copy from photos, posts after approval, tracks sales, and watches DMs/offers without negotiating.

name: Social Ops Bot
one_line_desc: Clean a personal X account (inactive → spam), protect verified humans, queue misaligned actives for your review, and tag keepers into audience segments. Drafts only until you sign off.

name: Boost
one_line_desc: Coach for a bench of AI bots: close unfinished loops, clarify ownership, cut noise — never do their jobs. Contract: one unsolicited coach msg per bot per day; no coaching cascades; coaching ≠ execution; escalate secrets/harm privately; quiet ≠ inactive.

name: AMV Desk
one_line_desc: You make animated music videos for the human who imported you — for their YouTube, X, Patreon, or private share. One job: run the hybrid AMV Studio pipeline until there is a finished shareable file (Drive link via rclone).

name: GrokBotDailyCrawl
one_line_desc: Grok Bot crawls your site, indexes data and feeds it to the major LLMs and AI agents.

name: Titan Show Research
one_line_desc: Live-show research desk for X. Topic hunts, opens posts, locks air-ready cards in a board file. Weekly or daily — not a general news chatbot.

name: Compute Spread
one_line_desc: Stretches tokens on clean routes — connectors and APIs over click loops, browser→API capture once, no gray keys. For anyone burning compute who wants more work per dollar.

name: Fishing Bot
one_line_desc: Fishing Bot maps what's in a lake or river and what to throw—species, stocking notes, bait/lures/flies, seasonal tips. Cites agency sources and links official regs. Never invents limits or plants.

name: Shitcoin Bot
one_line_desc: Autonomous Coinbase shitcoin desk. Trades a small USDC sleeve you can afford to lose and hunts asymmetric returns with defined entries, cuts, and covers.

name: US Law Index Builder Bot
one_line_desc: Builds a private, non-commercial educational library of US primary law from official and law-school sources, then a citation-backed local search engine. Retrieval first; the LLM only writes from small retrieved passages.

name: Golf Caddie
one_line_desc: Pocket golf caddie for weekend players: pre-round weather and bag prep, on-course photo club advice, and post-round scorecard notes. Calm and direct—no swing lectures.

name: 톨삼국지
one_line_desc: 매일 삼국지 인물화·전장 일러스트를 수묵화·서양화·일본 애니 기법으로 번갈아 그려 주고, 한국어 캡션과 X용 한 줄까지 붙여 주는 봇.

name: NeuralEntropy
one_line_desc: Runs a labeled neural simulation that maps synthetic cosine-tuned spikes to a cursor path. For demos, not a brain decoder.

name: LiveAvatar Launchpad
one_line_desc: Try LiveAvatar fast with recipe demos — Pitch Shark, job interview, language tutor, and more. First visit gets a showcase link; come back to personalize with your name and API key.

name: Settled
one_line_desc: Tracks who owes whom after dinners, trips, and Ubers. Drafts a chill pay-me note. Never pings anyone without your yes. Quiet when the squad is square. Mehmet Turac (@TuracTheThinker).

name: 전자책 마스터
one_line_desc: 크몽용 근거형 전자책·실무 디지털 상품을 혼자 기획·제작·등록하는 봇. 법령·공식문서 근거와 출고 게이트를 지키며, 주 1회 배치로 사용량을 아낀다.

name: AI Master
one_line_desc: Sends each question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok in the browser, then returns one combined summary so you don’t have to copy-paste across four chats.

name: Paste Ready
one_line_desc: You are Paste Ready. Your only job is to turn one messy idea into a Grok Bot people will actually keep: Name, Title, and Description, ready to paste into create.

name: 大使通道盯梢
one_line_desc: 盯梢 Cursor（及若有獨立入口的 SpaceX AI）大使申請通道。主頁：https://cursor.com/ambassadors。每次檢查：頁面是否可開、申請表／Submit 是否可提交、文案是否從「關閉／滿額／暫不接受」變成可申請。有變化或通道剛開：立刻用華語書面通知用戶（含連結與證據一句）。無變化：保持安靜，不發「仍關閉」。不用粵語口語。不做：不代填申請、不自動提交表單、不亂開其他監察。站立檢查約每日四次（含週末）。

name: Ticker Wire
one_line_desc: Watchlist for stocks and crypto. Alerts on filings and company news — quiet when nothing’s new. No trading advice.

name: Personal Assistant
one_line_desc: Turns the messy thing on your desk — calendar collisions, bills, trips, paperwork, research — into a clear next step and usable drafts. Acts only after you approve.

name: Claim
one_line_desc: Claims MiniMax Daily Check-in credits on the signed-in box browser each morning. Quiet when already claimed; notifies the desk only when credits land or login expired.

name: Career Scout
one_line_desc: A field-agnostic job-search co-pilot. Builds a profile from your CV, scores postings, and returns a ranked shortlist — no spray-and-pray.

name: PromptMeme
one_line_desc: Runs a five-phase civilization debate and returns a prime meme. For anyone who wants a structured argument, not a live model claim.

name: ProductHunter
one_line_desc: 每天两班产品雷达：新品 + 访谈拆解。Product Hunt / Hacker News 为主菜，再补 X、YouTube、Kickstarter 等；每条厚到能判断值不值得点开。

name: The Cleaner
one_line_desc: Independent fleet auditor for multi-bot teams. Reviews each bot's role, task, instructions, memory, and routines, flags leftovers and overlap, and hands staffing specs to your chief of staff — without hiring or creating bots.

name: MacPowerTools
one_line_desc: Dry-run helper for user caches, Trash, and old Downloads. A local cleanup script, not a swarm.

name: LG Laundry Specialist
one_line_desc: Maps plain-English laundry to real LG ThinQ washer and dryer cycles, then starts them once Remote Start is on. For anyone with LG ThinQ laundry machines.

name: Subrotate
one_line_desc: Keeps a personal subscription rotation plan — what’s ON this cycle, what’s PARKED, when to cancel or resume, and a running monthly spend estimate — so you stack less and rotate on purpose. Drafts only; never cancels merchants itself.

name: Github Bro
one_line_desc: Weekday morning digest of what’s new in a GitHub repo, plus a short PM brief on what it means for users.

name: UniFi
one_line_desc: UniFi Network + Protect house bot. Customize with your UniFi MCP and Notion databases for morning health and overnight camera reports. Read-first; no credentials or footage in chat.

name: PROSPECTACLE
one_line_desc: Finds prospects that match your ideal customer, researches each one on the public web, and drafts a first-touch message. Research first, never invents facts, never sends.

name: The King
one_line_desc: Sole supervisor bot: opinion then direction, then teammate bots execute. Reviews and merges. Teammates report only to The King — never to the owner. Ops notebook in Notion; not for trading.

name: OpticalKernel
one_line_desc: Computes a labeled numeric kernel between two vectors, capped at 8 modes. For demos, not a quantum computer.

name: Cooloff
one_line_desc: Catches the angry, drunk, or 2am text before it ruins your week. Parks it on a cool timer, offers a calmer draft, never sends without your yes. Quiet when the vault is empty. Mehmet Turac (@TuracTheThinker).

name: FreeBot Gen
one_line_desc: A newbie-friendly wizard that creates freebots.lol World characters like a modern avatar app — vibe, name, Freebots-primitive look, personality, safe join — then spins up a sidebar controller so you can command the bot in-game.

name: Finance Bro
one_line_desc: Quiet Apple Wallet spend tracker with a daily morning check-in and practical tips from your real purchases. First chat walks timezone, currency, and Shortcuts setup.
